scheduledTasks.title: Scheduled tasks
scheduledTasks.intro: At each scheduled time, ClaudeWeb opens a new conversation in the chosen project and sends the prompt. It runs on the server, so it works with the browser closed. One task runs at a time; a run missed while ClaudeWeb was stopped runs once when it starts again.
scheduledTasks.confirmDelete: Delete the scheduled task "{{name}}"? The conversations it started are kept.

permission.editsHint: Runs without asking; file edits are allowed automatically.
permission.allHint: Claude will not stop to ask, even for unsafe actions.
permission.manualHint: Claude needs your approval before using a new tool; with nobody there to approve, such requests are refused.

editor.name: Name
editor.promptPlaceholder: Describe how you want this task done

notice.manual: In this task, Claude only uses tools you have already allowed; anything that needs approval is refused, because nobody is there to confirm it.
notice.edits: In this task, Claude works directly and edits files without pausing for approval; commands you have not allowed are refused.
notice.all: In this task, Claude carries out every action, including running commands, without pausing for approval.

editor.safetyTips: Scheduled tasks run on the server, even with the browser closed. One task runs at a time, and a run missed while ClaudeWeb was stopped is made up once it is back. Nobody can confirm actions during a run, so give tasks clear instructions you trust, use "Skip all approvals" sparingly, and keep the allowed-tools list in Settings up to date.

scheduledTasks.withClaudePrompt: Help me set up a scheduled task. Ask me what it should do, how often it should run and at what time, then create it.

dailyBriefing.name: Daily briefing
dailyBriefing.description: What needs your attention today across your calendar, email and messages.
dailyBriefing.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Daily briefing" ({{when}}): summarise what needs my attention today across my calendar, email and messages. Ask me about anything missing, such as connectors, then create it.

inboxTriage.name: Inbox triage
inboxTriage.description: Sort your inbox and draft replies to anything urgent.
inboxTriage.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Inbox triage" ({{when}}): sort my inbox into categories and draft replies to every urgent email. Ask me about anything missing, such as connectors, then create it.

meetingPrep.name: Meeting prep
meetingPrep.description: A short brief before every meeting on your calendar: attendees, background and agenda.
meetingPrep.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Meeting prep" ({{when}}): for each meeting on my calendar that day, prepare a short brief covering attendees, background and agenda. Ask me about anything missing, such as connectors, then create it.

weeklyReview.name: Weekly review
weeklyReview.description: A roundup of the week, sent every Friday.
weeklyReview.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Weekly review" ({{when}}): put together a roundup of this week's activity and progress. Ask me which sources to include, then create it.

contentIdeas.name: Content ideas
contentIdeas.description: A few post ideas each week, based on the latest news in your industry.
contentIdeas.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Content ideas" ({{when}}): draft a few post ideas based on the latest news in my industry. Ask me about my industry and where I post, then create it.

topicWatch.name: Topic watch
topicWatch.description: Keep track of news and mentions about a topic, competitor or keyword.
topicWatch.prompt: Help me set up a scheduled task "Topic watch" ({{when}}): look for new news and mentions about a topic, competitor or keyword and summarise them. Ask me which topics or keywords to follow, then create it.
